492:t_000:3.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Location confirmed. We are above the Pacific Ocean in our original world.」

492:t_000:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Incidentally, a week has passed since we were sent to the world of darkness.」

492:t_000:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So there was a discrepancy in the timelines.」

492:t_000:6.en:
$$渓$$
「The other teams may be worried that we suddenly dropped out of contact.」

492:t_000:7.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「...I have just received an emergency transmission from the $$ラー・カイラム$$. They appear to have been calling continuously.」

492:t_000:10.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It says $$アマルガム$$ is going to destroy the world.」
